E-commerce Store in Coimbatore: packages and prices

Online stores with payments, shipping, GST invoices and inventory built in.

Quick answer

E-commerce Store from Vintorex Digital Solutions in Coimbatore starts at ₹34,999 for the Starter package and goes up to ₹1,49,999 for Premium, excluding 18% GST. Typical market prices run ₹25,000 to ₹4,00,000. Delivery: 3–8 weeks.

Prices reviewed October 2026. Excludes 18% GST.

Overview

A complete online store that takes UPI, card and COD payments, books shipping automatically, raises GST invoices and recovers abandoned carts. WooCommerce by default (no platform commission) or Shopify if you prefer.

Ideal for

  • Retailers and D2C brands going online
  • Wholesalers adding B2B ordering
  • Shops moving off marketplaces to their own store
